privacy: Reusable behavior only. No raw private session text.

cases.input: Two versions of one line survive.
cases.expected: Select one clean intended take and remove the duplicate.

cases.input: A sentence begins with a repeated first word.
cases.expected: Remove the false start and verify the join by retranscription.

cases.input: An unprotected word gap or mute stretch interrupts momentum.
cases.expected: Tighten to the profile target without deleting protected intent.

cases.input: The first three seconds do not create a truthful reason to continue.
cases.expected: Repair the 0-3 second window before body polish.

cases.input: The first 30 seconds lack proof, stakes, or a clear route.
cases.expected: Repair the complete 0-30 second viewer-leverage window.

cases.input: A recreation replaces available product footage.
cases.expected: Use real source screen proof when it truthfully shows the action.

cases.input: A callout or diagram label misstates the source.
cases.expected: Correct or remove the label; never improve clarity by changing the fact.

cases.input: The important product state is too small on mobile.
cases.expected: Promote proof to a legible layout and preserve its context.

cases.input: Eddy captions overlap readable captions in source footage.
cases.expected: Suppress Eddy captions for the collision interval.

cases.input: Speaker, captions, or graphics cover a proof target.
cases.expected: Change layout or safe zones and rerun collision checks.

cases.input: A motion frame explains itself with paragraphs.
cases.expected: Replace prose with a sparse label, icon, diagram, or mental model.

cases.input: Talking head or screen footage poorly explains a relationship.
cases.expected: Use HyperFrames to show the relationship spatially.

cases.input: A transition decorates without clarifying a state change.
cases.expected: Use a hard cut or assign a truthful semantic job.

cases.input: An automated punch-in adds motion but no meaning.
cases.expected: Remove it or document the exact communication job.

cases.input: The candidate has no suitable upbeat lo-fi bed.
cases.expected: Block until license-safe local, supplied, bundled, or locally generated music is documented.

cases.input: A meaningful state change has no restrained sonic cue.
cases.expected: Add a licensed, provenance-recorded cue when it improves comprehension.

cases.input: Camera exposure, skin, or white balance changes across shots.
cases.expected: Grade camera footage consistently while preserving screen color.

cases.input: A Short exists only to meet quota.
cases.expected: Drop it; output three to five only when each stands alone.

cases.input: A future word appears before it is spoken.
cases.expected: Keep future words invisible and highlight only the active word.

cases.input: The CTA arrives without a narrative bridge.
cases.expected: Repair the transition so the CTA follows the delivered value.

cases.input: A 100 score has checks without evidence.
cases.expected: Reject the score until every point has file, frame, timestamp, hash, playback, or measurement evidence.
